items.title: SpaceX signs $1.1 billion-per month computing deal
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian joins Market Domination host Ines Ferré to report that SpaceX (SPCX) has signed a $1.1 billion-per month AI computing deal.
